questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the literal meaning of diànyǐngyuàn?
What structure does zhèr fùjìn have?
What is often omitted in phrases of relative location?
Write the Chinese for "It's in this area."
Give the literal rendering of zhèr fùjìn.
Write the Chinese question meaning "Is the Dōngdān Movie Theater in this area?"

answers.answer_text: Dōngdān Diànyǐngyuàn shi bu shi zài zhèr fùjìn?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which question form is used here?

answers.answer_text: The shi bu shi yes/no-choice question.

questions_and_answers.question_text: At which intersection is the Dōngdān district?

answers.answer_text: At the intersection of Dōng Chángān Jiē and Dōngdān Běi Dàjiē.

articles.text:
1. A: Dōngdān Diànyǐngyuàn shi bu     Is the Dōngdān Movie Theater in
      shi zài zhèr fùjìn?             this area?
   B: Shì. Zài zhèr fùjìn.            Yes. It's in this area.

Notes on No. 1

Dōngdān is the name of a district in Běijīng to the east and south of the Palace Museum (Gùgōng), at the intersection of Dōng Chángān Jiē and Dōngdān Běi Dàjiē.

Literally, diànyǐngyuàn means "electric-shadow hall."

Zhèr fùjìn has the structure of a possessive phrase:

zhèr  |  (-de)  |  fùjìn
(there |  's    |  vicinity)

(The marker -de is often omitted in phrases of relative location.)
